name: billboard
title: Billboard
description: A board that runs ads as data: one or two lines of lettering in the world's display font beside a mark drawn in code that moves with the world clock (steam off a bowl, a watch's hands, a cell filling), cut to the next every `hold` seconds through torn strips. Its picture is redrawn only while near the camera. Lit at the world's screen luminance level. Decorative: no collider.
